snippet.title: DEAD ORBIT – Official Gameplay Trailer | Calm Space-Salvage Sim
snippet.description:
Low Earth orbit is full of the dead, and someone has to clean it up. 🛰️

DEAD ORBIT is a calm, physics-based space-salvage sim. Fly your salvage tug out of station S-12, plot real orbital transfers, and use harpoons, cutting lasers, and stabilizers to recover derelict satellites before a catastrophic cascade debris collision wipes out low Earth orbit.

ABOUT DEAD ORBIT:
• Plot & Fly: Real relative orbital mechanics with an intuitive autopilot or full Newtonian manual thrusters.
• Professional Salvage Tools: Harpoons, winches, high-energy cutting lasers, and stabilization clamp kits.
• Recycle & Expand: Tow wrecks to Station S-12, shred scrap into credits, and upgrade your tug, thrusters, and station modules.
• The Great Cascade: Debris collisions breed more debris on real clocks. Fortify your perimeter and stop high-speed fragments from destroying the station.

🛰️ Dead Orbit: a calm, physics-based space-salvage sim. In development.
